project.name: osgi/domains/incus
project.description: The incus domain: the external contacts toward an Incus host — one bundle pair, two contacts, because an Incus instance needs an Incus image (they are the same concern). incus-contract declares both verbs: the instance-reachability contact (IncusInstanceContact, shelled by incus-edge as `ssh … incus exec`, extracted from the host SeedSystemdAdapterEndpointGate) and the image-build contact (ImageBuilder, shelled by incus-edge as `distrobuilder build-incus` locally or its ssh recipe remotely, extracted from the host PulumiIncusImageProvider). incus-edge publishes both @Components. The host keeps the readiness orchestration and the Pulumi Image resource + cache, and composes each contact from the registry — the same shape as the shipped dbus-systemd and cluster edges.
